purpose: Technique-first editorial taxonomy for Drielo. Cross stitch, C2C crochet, tapestry crochet and latch hook share one bilingual content model while keeping technique hubs, SEO clusters and commerce targeting distinct.

routing.sections: Technique hubs can expose Learn, Ideas and Buying Guides as nested clean URLs.
routing.indexing: Only hubs and nested section pages with published content are added to Drielo sitemaps.

commerce.strategy: Articles automatically surface products and collections from the same technique when matching WooCommerce taxonomy exists.

optional_article_fields.product_skus: Ordered list of specific WooCommerce SKUs to feature before automatic recommendations.
optional_article_fields.collection_slugs: Ordered list of product_collection slugs to feature before automatically inferred collections.

visibility.now: All four techniques are part of the editorial architecture. Navigation can show empty techniques as coming soon without linking or indexing them.
visibility.later: New techniques can be added by extending the craft config and taxonomy without changing the article JSON schema.
